goal: SignalR review: hub authorisation, group membership and message validation.
use: SignalR review: hub authorisation, group membership and message validation. Use when a real-time hub is added or changed.

steps.note: List the hubs and the methods clients can call.
Check authorisation. Each hub method checks the caller's rights.
Check groups. Membership must be checked before a client joins a group.
Check messages. Incoming data must be validated like any request.
Report. Each hub method with file and line, severity and the fix.
